Technical SEO.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Deployed, Fourth of the Year
Technical SEO.summary: Google launched its fourth spam update of the year, the September 2026 spam update, alongside new multimodal search filters in Search Console and CrUX ad metrics added to Page Experience reporting. The video recap also notes a prior period of Google Search ranking volatility preceding the update.

Technical SEO.title: Google Has Deployed A New AI Spam Detector Called SAFE
Technical SEO.summary: Google has deployed a new AI-powered spam detection system called SAFE, which may be a component driving the September 2026 spam update. The article examines why this system is likely targeting AI-generated content spam at scale.

Technical SEO.title: WTF is NLWeb? - Whiteboard Friday
Technical SEO.summary: Crystal Carter explains the Natural Language Web and how the ASK protocol combined with structured data prepares sites for the agentic web. This is directly relevant to enterprise SEO teams building for AI-driven crawling and retrieval.

Technical SEO.title: The Text-Only Version Of Your Website Strips Out The Wrong Layer
Technical SEO.summary: The piece argues that stripping a site to markdown removes structural signals machines rely on, while removing only the visual layer still leaves a machine-usable site intact. This has direct implications for how enterprise sites render content for AI crawlers and answer engines.

Technical SEO.title: Google Posts Cracks Down On Unverified Contact Information
Technical SEO.summary: Google updated its Google Posts help documentation to restrict phone numbers in Posts to verified contact information only, with unverified numbers now disallowed. This is a policy change that affects local and enterprise Google Business Profile management at scale.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google AI Overviews Have More Links, But Not All Reach The Web
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google AI Overview links now route users either to external websites or to AI Mode, and Search Console measures those two interaction types differently. Enterprise SEOs need to understand this bifurcated attribution model to correctly assess organic traffic impact from AI Overviews.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Agents Wont Fix Bad Audience Data, Theyll Amplify It
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Skydeo's Mallory Gray argues that AI models used in GTM workflows will amplify poor audience signals rather than correct them, and that audience data quality matters more than mention counts for driving conversions. Relevant for enterprise teams integrating AI agents into content and targeting workflows.

AI Search / GEO.title: How to Optimize for AI Search: A Guide for You and Your AI Agent
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs outlines that optimizing for AI search remains grounded in core fundamentals, noting that Google states its AI search features still rely on its core search systems and that content must remain crawlable, indexable, and useful. Microsoft's guidance on the same topic is also referenced, making this a practical dual-platform GEO primer.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media analyzed over 13,000 citations across four major AI tools to identify citation patterns relevant to GEO strategy. Understanding which domains and content types earn AI citations is directly actionable for enterprise content teams targeting AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Emerges as the Holiday Seasons Fastest-Growing Service
AI Search / GEO.summary: A September 2026 press release reports that Generative Engine Optimization is the fastest-growing service category heading into the holiday season, signaling rapid enterprise adoption of GEO. Travel and retail verticals with high seasonal search intent are likely among the primary beneficiaries.

AI Search / GEO.title: Bing Tests Replacing Copilot With AI Mode In Search Tabs
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft is testing renaming the Copilot search tab in Bing to AI Mode, adopting the same terminology Google uses for its AI search product. Enterprise teams managing multi-platform GEO visibility should monitor this convergence as it may affect how AI search surfaces are branded and measured.
